desc: Retrieves comprehensive hardware and performance statistics from Windows including CPU/GPU temperatures, memory usage, disk activity, fan speed, load, processes, and driver details.

params.name: IncludeGPU
params.desc: If true, includes GPU temperature data (if available).

params.name: OutputFormat
params.desc: Desired output format: 'text' for console, 'json' for structured data.

params.name: FilterProcess
params.desc: Optional process name filter to display only matching processes.
